cues.text: Hey, I'm Agnes. I'm going to go over some knocking etiquette.
When you approach the door, give it a good firm knock.
You don't want it too soft where they can't hear,
but you also don't want the police banging knock.
Just a nice firm knock. I usually do a little pattern.
Then take a couple steps back and wait.
If there's no answer, give it a re-knock.
If there's still no answer, that's when you leave your card
and make sure you pin it on your app.
We'll go over how to pin doors in the next video.
